svg.title: Прокручивание роллера для предплечий — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Two close waist-up views. Both hands hold horizontal cylindrical wrist roller forward at chest height, elbows slightly bent fixed. One thin cord winds around its center and hangs vertically to small weight plate. Start long unwound cord and low plate, finish visibly wrapped cord and plate raised. Wrist winding only. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
